question: What streaming feature was released in the Go SDK on September 29, 2024?
ground_truth: The September 29, 2024 Go SDK release version 0.27.0 added support for SSE (Server-Sent Events) streaming responses. The user-facing interface for streaming responses remains the same between standard HTTP streaming and SSE.
